items.stem:

sols: An increase of 3.2% per year means multiplying by 1.032 each year.
correct to the nearest whole number
After 7 years: 24 000 × 1.032<sup>7</sup> = 29 920.5…, which is still less than 30 000.
After 8 years: 24 000 × 1.032<sup>8</sup> = 30 878.0…, which is greater than 30 000.
ms:
M1 for a correct trial with n = 7 or n = 8 (29 920 or 30 878 seen)
A1 cao

items.stem:
Hassan invests $12 000 in account A, which pays compound interest at a rate of r% per year.
After 5 years the value of this investment is $15 315.38.

Account B pays simple interest at a rate of 4.6% per year.

parts.t:
Calculate the value of r.
Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.
Calculate the value of $12 000 invested in account B for 5 years.
Work out how much more account A gives than account B over the 5 years.

sols: Let the yearly multiplier be k, so 12 000 × k5 = 15 315.38.
take the 5th root of the multiplier
The multiplier 1.05 means an increase of 0.05 = 5%.
Simple interest for one year = 4.6% of 12 000 = $552.
ms:
M1 for 15315.38 ÷ 12000 (= 1.27628…)
M1 for 5√their 1.27628… oe
A1 cao, accept 5

items.stem:
Jonas borrows $3600 for 6 months.

parts.t:

do not change 1.5% into a yearly rate
Simple interest = <sup>3600 × 1.5 × 6</sup>⁄<sub>100</sub> = $324, so he would repay 3600 + 324 = $3924.
compound interest charges interest on the interest

A multiplier of 0.8 means a decrease of 1 − 0.8 = 0.2 = 20%.

items.stem:
Two friends each invest $2000 on the same day.
Leo’s account pays 6% per year simple interest.
Mia’s account pays 5% per year compound interest.

parts.t: Write down the value of Leo’s investment after 8 years.

Calculate the value of Mia’s investment after 8 years.
Give your answer correct to the nearest cent.
Find the least number of complete years after which Mia’s investment is worth more than Leo’s.

sols: Simple interest each year = 6% of 2000 = $120, so 8 years gives 8 × 120 = $960.
After 8 years Leo has $2960 and Mia has $2954.91, so Leo is still ahead.
After 9 years: Leo has 2000 + 9 × 120 = $3080; Mia has 2000 × 1.05<sup>9</sup> = $3102.66.
Mia’s interest grows each year while Leo’s stays at $120
ms:
M1 for both values after 9 years (3080 and 3102.66) or a comparison for n = 8 and n = 9
A1 cao
